verdict.rationale: Next.js documents async server components that await their data ('Make your React component async and await your data'), plus zero-JS server components and Suspense streaming, which covers the server-side fetching half of the story. Handing that data as props to interactive client components is only implied: the pack has nothing first-party on the server-to-client boundary, and community notes on SSR+SPA rendering are general rather than specific. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of passing server-fetched data to interactive client components, independent hands-on corroboration of the server-to-client data flow.

support.subject: As a developer, I can fetch data in asynchronous server-rendered components and pass it down to interactive client components

citations.quote: Make your React component async and await your data.
